name: list_calendars
description: Returns the calendars and reminder lists on this Mac from every account it syncs (iCloud, Google, Exchange and others). `primary` marks the default of each kind.

kind.description: Optional. `events` for calendars or `reminders` for reminder lists. Default: both.

name: create_calendar
description: Creates a calendar or a reminder list.

kind.description: Optional. `events` for a calendar or `reminders` for a reminder list. Default: `events`.

account.description: Optional. The account to create it in, as `list_calendars` names it. Default: the account of the default calendar or list.

name: update_calendar
description: Renames or recolors a calendar or reminder list.

calendarId.description: Required. ID of the calendar or reminder list.

name: delete_calendar
description: Deletes a calendar or reminder list with everything in it, and returns it as it was.

calendarId.description: Required. ID of the calendar or reminder list.

name: list_events
description: Returns the events that overlap a time range, each occurrence of a repeating event on its own, sorted by start.

calendarId.description: Optional. ID of the calendar containing the events, from `list_calendars`. Default: every calendar.

startTime.description: Optional. The lower bound of the time range. ISO 8601 time, for example `2026-04-30T10:00:00`. Pass the local time with no UTC offset and no trailing `Z`; only include an offset if the user themselves stated one. Default: now.

endTime.description: Optional. The upper bound of the time range. Default: `startTime` + 7 days.

timeZone.description: Optional. The time zone (IANA ID, for example `Europe/Zurich`) used to read and show times. Only set it when the user names a time zone. Default: this Mac's time zone.

fullText.description: Optional. Case-insensitive text matched against the title, notes and location.

pageSize.description: Optional. Max results per page (default `100`, max `250`).

pageToken.description: Optional. The `nextPageToken` of the previous page.

eventId.description: Required. The ID of the event.

timeZone.description: Optional. The time zone (IANA ID, for example `Europe/Zurich`) used to read and show times. Only set it when the user names a time zone. Default: this Mac's time zone.

name: create_event
description: Creates an event. Apple cannot invite guests; use a Google calendar for invitations.

calendarId.description: Optional. ID of the calendar to create the event on. Default: the default calendar.

url.description: Optional. A link stored with the event.

startTime.description: Start time. ISO 8601 time, for example `2026-04-30T10:00:00`. Pass the local time with no UTC offset and no trailing `Z`; only include an offset if the user themselves stated one.

endTime.description: End time. Follows the same rules as `startTime`.

allDay.description: Optional. Whether the event spans whole days. If true, `startTime` and `endTime` are read as dates and `endTime` is the day after the last one.

timeZone.description: Optional. The time zone (IANA ID, for example `Europe/Zurich`) used to read and show times. Only set it when the user names a time zone. Default: this Mac's time zone.

recurrenceData.description: Optional. Recurrence rules as `RRULE` strings (per RFC 5545), for example `RRULE:FREQ=WEEKLY;BYDAY=MO,WE;COUNT=10`. Apple stores FREQ (DAILY, WEEKLY, MONTHLY, YEARLY), INTERVAL, COUNT, UNTIL, BYDAY, BYMONTHDAY, BYMONTH and BYSETPOS.

overrideReminders.description: Optional. Alerts before the event. An empty list removes every alert.

method.description: Optional. Apple shows every alert as a notification; `popup` is the only method.

minutes.description: Required. Minutes before the start that the alert fires.

name: update_event
description: Changes the fields given and keeps the rest. An occurrence's ID changes that occurrence only; the `recurringEventId` changes the whole series. Moving only `startTime` keeps the length.

eventId.description: Required. The ID of the event.

destinationCalendarId.description: Optional. ID of a calendar to move the event to.

description.description: Optional. Notes. An empty string removes it.

location.description: Optional. Location. An empty string removes it.

url.description: Optional. A link stored with the event. An empty string removes it.

startTime.description: Start time. ISO 8601 time, for example `2026-04-30T10:00:00`. Pass the local time with no UTC offset and no trailing `Z`; only include an offset if the user themselves stated one.

endTime.description: End time. Follows the same rules as `startTime`.

allDay.description: Optional. Whether the event spans whole days. If true, `startTime` and `endTime` are read as dates and `endTime` is the day after the last one.

timeZone.description: Optional. The time zone (IANA ID, for example `Europe/Zurich`) used to read and show times. Only set it when the user names a time zone. Default: this Mac's time zone.

recurrenceData.description: Optional. Recurrence rules as `RRULE` strings (per RFC 5545), for example `RRULE:FREQ=WEEKLY;BYDAY=MO,WE;COUNT=10`. Apple stores FREQ (DAILY, WEEKLY, MONTHLY, YEARLY), INTERVAL, COUNT, UNTIL, BYDAY, BYMONTHDAY, BYMONTH and BYSETPOS.

overrideReminders.description: Optional. Alerts before the event. An empty list removes every alert.

method.description: Optional. Apple shows every alert as a notification; `popup` is the only method.

minutes.description: Required. Minutes before the start that the alert fires.

name: delete_event
description: Deletes an event and returns it as it was. An occurrence's ID deletes that occurrence only; the `recurringEventId` deletes the whole series.

eventId.description: Required. The ID of the event to delete.

name: list_reminders
description: Returns reminders sorted by due time, open ones by default.

listId.description: Optional. ID of the reminder list, from `list_calendars`. Default: every list.

startTime.description: Optional. Only reminders due at or after this time. ISO 8601 time, for example `2026-04-30T10:00:00`. Pass the local time with no UTC offset and no trailing `Z`; only include an offset if the user themselves stated one.

endTime.description: Optional. Only reminders due at or before this time.

timeZone.description: Optional. The time zone (IANA ID, for example `Europe/Zurich`) used to read and show times. Only set it when the user names a time zone. Default: this Mac's time zone.

fullText.description: Optional. Case-insensitive text matched against the title and notes.

pageSize.description: Optional. Max results per page (default `100`, max `250`).

pageToken.description: Optional. The `nextPageToken` of the previous page.

listId.description: Optional. ID of the reminder list. Default: the default list.

url.description: Optional. A link stored with the reminder.

due.description: Optional. A date such as `2026-04-30`, or a time. ISO 8601 time, for example `2026-04-30T10:00:00`. Pass the local time with no UTC offset and no trailing `Z`; only include an offset if the user themselves stated one.

alerts.description: Optional. Alerts as minutes before the due time; needs a due time. An empty list removes every alert.

recurrenceData.description: Optional. Recurrence rules as `RRULE` strings; needs a due date. An empty list stops the repeat.

timeZone.description: Optional. The time zone (IANA ID, for example `Europe/Zurich`) used to read and show times. Only set it when the user names a time zone. Default: this Mac's time zone.

name: update_reminder
description: Changes the fields given and keeps the rest. `completed: true` completes the reminder and `completed: false` reopens it.

reminderId.description: Required. The ID of the reminder.

listId.description: Optional. ID of a reminder list to move the reminder to.

notes.description: Optional. Notes. An empty string removes it.

url.description: Optional. A link stored with the reminder. An empty string removes it.

due.description: Optional. A date such as `2026-04-30`, or a time. ISO 8601 time, for example `2026-04-30T10:00:00`. Pass the local time with no UTC offset and no trailing `Z`; only include an offset if the user themselves stated one. An empty string removes it.

alerts.description: Optional. Alerts as minutes before the due time; needs a due time. An empty list removes every alert.

recurrenceData.description: Optional. Recurrence rules as `RRULE` strings; needs a due date. An empty list stops the repeat.

timeZone.description: Optional. The time zone (IANA ID, for example `Europe/Zurich`) used to read and show times. Only set it when the user names a time zone. Default: this Mac's time zone.

completed.description: Optional. Whether the reminder is done.

name: delete_reminder
description: Deletes a reminder and returns it as it was.

reminderId.description: Required. The ID of the reminder.

name: search_contacts
description:
Search the contacts on this Mac by name, email address or phone number. Without a query, lists every contact.

If this tool returns more than one result, present them and ask the user which one they mean before acting on one.

query.description: Optional. A name, email address or phone number.
